name: Dendro DMG
description:
Applies Dendro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
Every 1 Elemental Mastery increases the specified effect by a factor of 1.
Bloom: Create 1 stack of Dendro Core
Burning: Apply 1 stack of Perpetual Burn to the target
Quicken: Create 2 stacks of Catalyzing Field (Max 2 stacks)
